course_rules.note: TAU: annual course, taught in semesters 5 and 6, final exam in 6. Enforced by data/boards/mechanical_engineering_2027.json: is_annual=true, spans_semesters=[year_3_semester_a, year_3_semester_b], count_hours_once=true (audited by board_audit annual checks).

TAU: 0542-4011/0542-4012 are open only to students in years 2-3 of the faculty excellence program. The board offers them to everyone in years 3-4 (other_specialization, effective_allowed_semesters year_3/year_4).
TAU: 0542-1510 is identical to 0509-1510 ("קורס זהה לקורס מספר 0509.1510"); the source states only that the courses are identical. The board has no equivalence data.
TAU: students of the Music-Tech cluster (מקבץ "מיוזיק-טק") are exempt from the שאר רוח requirement. Neither the spec nor the board models cohorts.

TAU: for 0512-4362 the prerequisite can be recognized through 0542-3243 (מבוא לבקרה) ("ניתן להכיר כתנאי קדם במבוא לבקרה 0542-3243"). The board record carries no prerequisite list for 0512-4362 (only prerequisites_url).

TAU: 0542-2500 is taken in semester 4 or 5 (Y2/B or Y3/A). The boards fix it instead: years 1-2 board allowed_semesters [year_2_semester_b], years 3-4 board [year_3_semester_a]; no single choice between the two.
TAU: 0509-4010 is for 4th-year students only (admission interview after registration). The board allows it in year 3 too (effective_allowed_semesters includes year_3_semester_b).

known_gaps.description: The faculty undergraduate regulations (תקנון הלימודים לתואר ראשון, https://engineering.tau.ac.il/sites/engineering.tau.ac.il/files/media_server/Engineering/yedion/Terms_BA.pdf) are only linked from the program page and were not read; they may hold planning rules (e.g. semester load limits, repeat or exemption rules) the spec does not express.
